tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Senior backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, extending and supporting large-scale e-commerce and web platforms using Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices for global clients like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong foundation in backend development, API integration, database query optimization, and CI/CD pipelines. Experienced in working within agile teams, collaborating with business and technical stakeholders, and delivering robust, scalable solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: senior fullstack developer dm app und onlineshop kotlin spring boot react typescript w m d
cover_en.hook: As an experienced software engineer based in Karlsruhe with a strong focus on enterprise backend development and robust API architectures, I am excited to apply for the senior developer role at dm-drogerie markt. Over the past 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have engineered scalable backend services, RESTful APIs, and complex web platform integrations using Java, Spring, and modern cloud technologies.

bullets.label: Spring Boot & Backend Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring for enterprise e-commerce platforms, ensuring high system stability and performance.

bullets.label: API Integration & Data Flows
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, integrating third-party consumers and building seamless data pipelines across enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and SQL performance tuning that reduced response latency and significantly improved transaction speed in production environments.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles, release builds, and automated testing suites within agile DevOps workflows alongside international technical and business teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026 and am available to start from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my backend expertise can contribute to dm-drogerie markt.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als senior fullstack developer dm app und onlineshop kotlin spring boot react typescript w m d
cover_de.hook: Als erfahrene Softwareentwicklerin mit Wohnsitz in Karlsruhe und fundierter Expertise in der Entwicklung skalierbarer Backend-Architekturen und REST-Schnittstellen, bewerbe ich mich mit großer Begeisterung bei dm-drogerie markt. In den vergangenen 5+ Jahren bei Unternehmen wie Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich erfolgreich enterprise-fähige Plattformen mit Java, Spring und modernen Web-Technologien mitgestaltet.

bullets.label: Spring Boot & Backend-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Implementierung robuster Backend-Funktionalitäten sowie REST-Webservices mit Java und Spring zur Unterstützung performanter Webanwendungen.

bullets.label: API-Integration & Schnittstellen
bullets.text: Konzeption und Bereitstellung von OCC-REST-Webservices und Headless-APIs für nahtlose Datenflüsse und die Anbindung externer Verbraucher.

bullets.label: Datenbank-Optimierung
bullets.text: Durchführung von SQL-Query-Refactoring und Performance-Tuning zur Reduzierung von Latenzen und Erhöhung der Transaktionsgeschwindigkeit in Produktionssystemen.

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit & CI/CD
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds innerhalb agiler DevOps-Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für Sie tätig sein kann. Über ein persönliches Gespräch freue ich mich sehr.

tailoring.why_company: dm-drogerie markt stands for customer-centric retail and digital innovation right here in Karlsruhe. I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise backend and API development experience to help build reliable, high-performance digital services for millions of users.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise Java, Spring Boot and API expertise to build high-performance digital platforms at dm-drogerie markt in Karlsruhe.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an experienced backend developer based in Karlsruhe with 5+ years building enterprise Spring and REST applications at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed your opening at dm and would love to connect about how my background fits your team.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the senior developer position at dm-drogerie markt. With over 5 years of professional experience building scalable backend solutions, Spring applications, and REST APIs for enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical expertise and a results-driven approach.

Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, I am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
